summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Regulatory News Service announcement of a PDMR share transaction. Chief Risk Officer Stephen Shelley sold 4,000,000 ordinary shares of 10 pence each on 9 September 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 110.9827 pence per share, executed in two tranches (2,518,379 at GBP 1.108500; 1,481,621 at GBP 1.112083) on the London Stock Exchange. The filing notes Shelley continues to exceed the Group's shareholding policy requirements. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are implicated; this is a routine insider disposal notification, not a special situation.
